اؤتمن (form VIII)
# اُؤْتُمِنَ (uʔtumina) /uʔ.tu.mi.na/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اُؤْتُمِنَّ (uʔtuminna) /uʔ.tu.min.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
